user.title: Voice Alarms
user.description: Alarms and reminders for your voice satellites. All settings can be changed later.

data.ramp_start: Start level of the volume ramp
data.alarm_volume: Satellite volume while ringing (leave empty to keep the current volume)
data.default_sound: Alarm sound (URL or media-source id, empty = built-in sound)
data.reminder_repeats: How often a reminder is spoken
data.missed_grace: Still ring an alarm if it was missed by at most
data.device_stop_pause: When the alarm is stopped on the device itself, resume ringing after (0 = treat as dismissed)

error.invalid_sound: Use an http(s) URL, a path starting with / or a media-source:// id.

add_alarm.name: Add alarm
add_alarm.description: Create an alarm or reminder on a voice satellite.

target.name: Satellite
target.description: The assist satellite the alarm rings on.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date for a one-time alarm (YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow, weekday name). Ignored when weekdays are set.

weekdays.name: Repeat on
weekdays.description: Weekdays (mon..sun) for a repeating alarm. Leave empty for a one-time alarm.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to speak. Makes this a reminder instead of an alarm.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: alarm or reminder (derived from the message when omitted).

duration.name: Ring duration
duration.description: Seconds the alarm sound plays. Defaults to the integration setting.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: URL or media-source id of a custom sound for this alarm.

target.name: Satellite
target.description: Move the alarm to this satellite.

date.name: Date
date.description: New date for a one-time alarm.

weekdays.name: Repeat on
weekdays.description: New weekdays; empty list makes it one-time.

skip_next.name: Skip next occurrence
skip_next.description: Skip (or reinstate) only the next occurrence of a repeating alarm.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Stop a ringing alarm or reminder.

target.name: Satellite
target.description: Only stop the alarm on this satellite. Leave empty to stop all.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Stop a ringing alarm and ring it again in a few minutes.

target.name: Satellite
target.description: Only snooze the alarm on this satellite. Leave empty for all.

list_alarms.name: List alarms
list_alarms.description: Return all alarms and what is currently ringing.

test_alarm.name: Test alarm
test_alarm.description: Ring the alarm sound (or speak a reminder) on a satellite right now.

message.name: Message
message.description: Speak this as a reminder instead of ringing.
